title: wow: Convert dissector to use autogenerated definitions
description:
Sorry for the massive MR. I tried splitting it up into as many commits as I could but some of the changes are just necessarily huge.

This MR:

* Fixes the `wow` dissector to work with all valid protocol versions using auto generated definitions from [wow_messages](https://github.com/gtker/wow_messages).
* Converts the dissector to use `ptvcursor`.
* Makes message layout dependent on provided protocol version rather than game version.
* Makes the logic for figuring out message layouts local to individual conversations rather than global.

I used [all_protocol_versions_login.pcapng](/uploads/07dc41cfa8a1a7607934c8b351dbcec4/all_protocol_versions_login.pcapng), a file where every possible protocol version connects to a server in sequence. This file is broken prior to this MR, since the version based message parsing isn't accurate enough.

I tried to keep everything as close to how it's done in the `woww` dissector as possible, since it's also auto generated from the same source.
